items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Would it play anything like Piku or George Lewis or Edmund Hall or Johnny Dog? [INTERVIEWEE] Well I don't know. To me, I don't know.

ctx.x: And you had a heavy reason. That was for the reason. It was loud? Yeah. It was loud.

I'm supposed to tell you. Well how about these other fellas, Zeb and Pill and all that? Who would you say that they played like who's playing now that we would know? Would it play anything like Piku or George Lewis or Edmund Hall or Johnny Dog?
Well I don't know. To me, I don't know. Know the- You catch a... Well, Lou and them were inspired to clarinet lead in them days.
